issue.title: 45° back frames and cushions use inconsistent painter ordering for complex arrangements
issue.status: The piece-row-first sort fixed L-shape cross-row occlusion. Same-row ordering uses layer rank which is correct for linear sofas. Remaining issues are with chaise/corner depth sorting in oblique views.
issue.next-step: Test all 6 presets in both camera angles. Audit any remaining inside-out or show-through artifacts.

issue.title: Arm geometry needs per-camera-direction face selection refinement
issue.status: Current arm rendering uses armFacesInterior to choose inner vs outer panel. Round arm style produces a curved silhouette but may not fully convince as a Pottery Barn-style rounded front.
issue.next-step: Model arm front/end as separate surfaces with explicit visibility per camera. Reference CW product photos for round arm silhouette accuracy.

issue.title: Ottoman back rendering and corner orientation need capability-map enforcement
issue.status: The hasBack check exists (piece.kind !== 'ottoman') and corner return-back logic exists. Verify no leaking in all 12 test cases.
issue.next-step: Add explicit capability map: { hasBackFrame, hasBackCushion, armSides, openEdges } per piece kind. Never infer from grid position.

issue.title: Pricing catalog uses embedded snapshot prices, not live Shopify API
issue.status: Prices are baked in from the Shopify products.json snapshot. Lazy fetch exists but fallback prices may go stale.
issue.next-step: Wire lazy fetch to always check Shopify first, fall back to embedded prices only on network failure.

architecture.module: Owns dialog UI, stage SVG rendering, presets, undo/redo, multi-select, dimension lines, theme swatches, pricing panel, model controls, and the "Use in project" handoff. Delegates canvas manipulation to ImportLiveAssembly and refreshLiveAssembly.

45° product view projection, surface creation, layering, arm geometry, semantic review annotations. Camera projection via productProjection(). Surface visibility via productPanelFacesCamera(). Painter sort by piece row → layer rank → surface depth.
Pure function converting a SectionalPiece + theme into a fabric.Group at SVG-pixel coordinates. Caller positions/scales into world space.

ensureParametricListener registers on canvas: object:moving (snap + refresh), object:scaling/rotating (refresh), object:modified (commit + persist). refreshLiveAssembly recomputes all linked stroke positions and values. applyMeasurementToLiveAssembly provides bidirectional editing. persistLiveAssemblyTransforms saves to metadata. restoreLiveSectionalTransform reads them back on reopen.

Embedded product catalog from 5 Shopify collections (49 products). getPiecePricing(piece) maps kind+mirror → CW product. getAssemblyPricing(pieces) computes total. Multi-country with lazy Shopify fetch.
Auto-spawns Express backend when Vite dev server starts. Forwards stdout as [api] prefixed lines. Auto-restarts on crash. Kills on Vite shutdown.

cw-catalog-reference.style-code-families: Loose-fit products carry: CNRP + LSKT + MLTP (×PC/PM/SP = 9 tags) Snug-fit products carry: SHRT + SNUG (×PC/PM/SP = 6 tags) Cushion-covers-only carry: bare PC/PM/SP (3 tags)
cw-catalog-reference.product-ref-grammar: CS{size}{seat}-{arm}-{fit/orientation} Size: 0=Ottoman, 1=Chair, 2=Loveseat, 3=Sofa, 5=Chaise Seat: B=Boxed, L=T/L-cushion, X=None/armless Example: CS1B-SRA-L = 1-seat boxed, Single Round Arm, Left-facing
